profiling.speedup_caveat: Ideal bound removes measured Vision Tower + Projector + img_adapter only, assumes zero added management cost; not an achievable or measured speedup
profiling.prefill_decode: Not separately measured; llm_generation_ms covers original autoregressive generation after multimodal preparation

objects.definition: intersection / previous instance count; empty previous set is undefined, not zero

statistical_unit: Unweighted mean of within-scene means; 95% percentile bootstrap over scene means. CI undefined with <2 scenes. Latency percentiles describe recorded requests/repeats, not independent scene samples.

sources.redundancy: nuScenes per-camera sample_data keyframes and sweeps
sources.profiling: existing Senna planning evaluation JSON and original local inference helper
sources.matched: exact six keyframe image paths + sample token + scene, verified against camera_manifest; matched_profile_pairs.csv only
